messages:
nina: opening idea for a compact 'risk-composite' gate for v4q-longdoc bring-up. want to collapse quality/latency/cost/infra into a single index so autofallbacks are easier to reason about.

oscar: makes sense. what inputs do you want?

nina: propose: concordance_vs_gold (rouge_l_f1 delta), ner_halluc_pct, entropy_divergence (vs baseline output probs), p99 latency (abs + %uplift), kv_miss_per_1k, tokens_per_session_delta. normalize to 0..1, weighted sum. trigger if composite_score >= 0.78 sustained per window.

li: add a 'truthiness' check: cosine similarity of entities to gold embeddings; that helps catch paraphrase-escape hallucinations. low weight but useful.

nina: good — add entity_sim_delta low weight. default weights: concordance:0.42, ner_halluc:0.18, entropy_div:0.12, latency:0.15, kv_miss:0.07, tokens:0.04, entity_sim:0.02. context tweak: if seq_len>2048 multiply latency weight x1.7 and reduce concordance weight x0.85.

sam: safety preconditions: require (canary_traffic_pct>=2%) OR (num_independent_slices_firing>=3) to allow auto-rollback. otherwise stick to alert-only. tiny cohorts noisy.

nina: two-tier thresholds: alert_score=0.6 (10m smooth), soft_auto=0.9 (3m sustain) for first 12h, then drop auto to 0.8. ops asked for conservative early autos.

dev-bot: deploybot: canary started for model:v4q-longdoc at 2026-03-25T11:12:00Z cohort=0.5%. monitoring hooks: concordance_vs_gold, ner_halluc_pct, entropy_divergence, latency_p99_ms, kv_miss_per_1k, tokens_per_session_pct, entity_sim_delta.

aria: UI ask: Console should show stacked bar of per-signal weighted contribution + the raw signal timeseries. also expose which slices contributed most to the composite when triggered.

li: please include an opt-in debug dump for canary cohort that captures per-request vector (anonymized ids) to S3 for triage.

nina: pasted minimal orchestration payload i'm sending to staging (compact, for orchestration API):

```
{
"policy_name":"risk_composite_v1",
"inputs":["concordance_vs_gold","ner_halluc_pct","entropy_divergence","latency_p99_ms","latency_pct_uplift","kv_miss_per_1k","tokens_per_session_pct","entity_sim_delta"],
"weights":[0.42,0.18,0.12,0.15,0.0,0.07,0.04,0.02],
"normalize":"robust_minmax",
"latency_abs_p99_ms":430,
"scoring":{"method":"weighted_sum","alert_score":0.6,"soft_auto_score":0.9,"post_watch_auto_score":0.8,"alert_window_min":10,"soft_auto_window_min":3},
"context_adjust":[{"if":"seq_len>2048","apply":{"latency_mul":1.7,"concordance_mul":0.85}}],
"preconds":{"min_canary_pct":2.0,"min_slices_firing":3},
"actions":{"on_alert":"notify:#eng-ml","on_soft_auto":"notify:#oncall","on_auto":"rollback_and_create_incident"}
}
```

nina: i'll push to staging and run a 30m shadow against a synthetic longdoc set (200 examples: halluc-prone entities + multi-turn). will post results here.

aria: thanks — also request the Console include a 'why' view that lists top-3 signals by contribution and representative example queries when triggered.

sam: ack. tagging @eng-ml for a smoke tomorrow morning. nina, please paste the staging link when available.

nina: will do. thumbs up everyone :rocket:
